span.label: whether the active components of working memory can operate without intention and outside conscious awareness
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: shows across five studies that patterns are extracted, maintained and used to bias responding without intention or awareness, and argues the field's view of working memory must widen to include an implicit mode

span.term: Incidental extraction of the pattern generates an anticipation of the next disk's location, which speeds responses when the anticipation is correct and slows them when it is violated

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Conscious, intentional search for patterns produces frequent failures on the pattern-less majority of sets, and those failures interfere with the implicit extraction process
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Discovering a pattern itself imposes a brief processing cost - an implicit 'aha' - that partly cancels the speedup it produces

span.label: the field's instruments are read as evidence about the field: every standard WM task is explicit, so the tasks record what researchers believe rather than test it

span.label: the question cannot be asked with the existing instruments because they presuppose its answer, so the paradigm has to be built before the experiment can exist

span.label: a functional definition is adopted deliberately, so that whether the new task counts as a working memory task is settled by what it requires rather than by precedent

span.label: the design forecloses statistical learning by construction: pattern-following and pattern-breaking endings are equiprobable, so learning history predicts chance on the critical disk
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the first block is analysed separately as the empirical version of the same argument, since each pattern has appeared only once and there is nothing yet to have learned
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: awareness is attacked from four directions rather than one — open debriefing, immediate reconstruction, forced-choice recognition, and a correlation between reconstructed and actual moves
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: in the fourth study awareness is manipulated instead of measured, which converts a null result about awareness into a predicted dissociation

span.label: the excluded participants are turned into a test: if awareness drove the effect it should be larger in those who noticed the patterns, and it is smaller

span.label: a self-undermining fact — that every finite sequence follows some rule — is stated and then shown to bias the study against its own hypothesis

span.label: the alternative account is not tested but reasoned through: imagine long-term memory doing this task, and it turns out to need the very operations attributed to working memory

span.label: stimulus position is jittered specifically to block a strategy that would let attention narrow to the local level and bypass the global stimulus

span.label: Whether pattern naming, anticipation and control are done by working memory alone or by working memory interacting with long-term memory is left unresolved.
